name: Bender
look: A still from Futurama: Bender, the gray robot, wears a big white fur coat and scowls with narrowed eyes while holding up one hand mid-gesture. Behind him on the left, a green robot woman with long dark hair glares, in front of an orange-red wall with pipes.
use: Bender, rejected or left out, announces he'll make his own version of the thing, only better. Captions usually follow "I'm going to build my own ___, with blackjack and hookers", often with a cleaner ending swapped in.
slots: top: I'm going to make my own ___
examples: Not invited to the barbecue? I'll throw my own barbecue
With blackjack and extra hot dogs
Fine, I'll start my own book club
With blackjack and no actual books
